crossRefs.note: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in…
Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be…
So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria…
For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken…
For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father,’ and, ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria…
All the people will know, including Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria, who say in pride and in arrogance of heart,
Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of…
Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.
They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.
Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel.
Seek Yahweh, and you will live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one…
“Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Gozan
people.line: A region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives were deported.

people.name: Habor
people.line: A river in Assyria where Israelite captives were settled.

people.name: Halah
people.line: A place where Israelites were exiled by the Assyrians.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Media
people.line: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire

translations.web: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
translations.bsb: The king of Assyria exiled the Israelites to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan by the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.
translations.kjv: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
translations.asv: And the king of Assyria carried Israel away unto Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,
